Subject: Discovery follow-up: procurement path & approvals for Redwood trial

Hi Alex + procurement team,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward a pilot: 

Call recap (short):
- Pilot: 6-week inference trial scoped to 2 production routes (chat + embedding)
- Key success: <10% latency increase vs baseline, cost under target, and no PII egress
- Redwood asks: vendor form, PO or card preference, budget owner sign-off, any required NDAs/vendor addenda

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement path: PO (net terms) vs company card vs AWS Marketplace. If PO, confirm required PO language and who signs.
2) Please share name/email of the budget owner (economic buyer) and the finance sponsor who will approve payment terms.
3) If you need us to complete a vendor onboarding form, attach it here or point to the shared upload.
4) We attached a draft SOW and a procurement checklist to speed review.

Attachments: Skyline_Redwood_MUTD_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF) | Procurement_Checklist_Skyline.xlsx (Excel)

If helpful, we can produce an itemized quote and a one-page vendor packet for procurement by tomorrow. What timeline works for you to get internal approvals?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0146

Thanks Ben — good recap. A few answers from procurement side: 

- Procurement path: Our preference is PO with net 30. Marketplace is under evaluation at the org level but PO will be fastest for this pilot.
- Budget owner (economic buyer): Dr. Priya Shah, Director of Data Science (priya.shah@skylinehealth.com).
- Finance sponsor: Ben Larsen, VP Finance (ben.larsen@skylinehealth.com).
- Signatory: Mateo Ruiz, General Counsel (mateo.ruiz@skylinehealth.com) typically signs, but he may delegate signature authority to procurement for pilots under $50k.
- Timeline: We are targeting approval by Aug 26 to start pilot in early September.

Procurement asks: Please send an itemized quote and our vendor form (attached) completed if possible. Also include an account contact for security/compliance evidence — we may loop in InfoSec.
